name: selective-context-trim
description: Selective Context Trim: lets the agent inspect and surgically trim its own context (by tool_use_id and/or regex; stub, summary or delete), flags older copies that a newer result makes redundant on its own (edited files re-read, commands re-run, repeated sections) plus older results of its own inspect/trim tools, with a cache-aware cost/benefit guard, a single-slot .jsonl_trim-backup, a verified /resume reload and automatic rollback.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: Which cache write price the cost model uses. auto follows the lifetime the API's own usage reports (falls back to 5m).

cacheReadMultiplier.title: Cache read price multiplier
cacheReadMultiplier.description: Price of a cache read relative to base input. 0 picks it from the model (0.1x, 0.05x on Opus/Sonnet 5.5, 0.025x on Fable/Mythos 5.1).

assumedRemainingRequests.title: Assumed remaining requests
assumedRemainingRequests.description: How many more model requests a trim is assumed to benefit when the agent does not say. Higher = more permissive.

minSavingsTokens.title: Minimum tokens saved
minSavingsTokens.description: Trims freeing fewer estimated tokens than this are refused as not worth a reload.

sizeableTokens.title: Sizeable-trim threshold (tokens)
sizeableTokens.description: A single trim saving at least this much is judged on its long-term payback instead of having to beat the tokens it forces the cache to recompute.

lookbackBlocks.title: Cache lookback (blocks)
lookbackBlocks.description: How many content blocks back the API looks for a surviving cache entry (20 per Anthropic's docs). Raise it if your setup places extra cache breakpoints in the history.

reloadStrategy.title: Reload strategy
reloadStrategy.description: auto: try /resume <id>, fall back to /clear then /resume <id> if it does not reload. direct or clear-resume force one.

resumeTimeoutMs.title: Resume watchdog (ms)
resumeTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the reloaded session before rolling back to the backup.

autoContinue.title: Auto-continue
autoContinue.description: After a successful reload, prompt the agent to continue its task.

charsPerToken.title: Characters per token
charsPerToken.description: Estimate used to convert sizes to tokens (code is about 3.5).

nudges.title: Hints after large results
nudges.description: After a large tool result, add a one-line hint (with its tool_use_id) reminding the agent it can flag the result for trimming once it is finished with it. Costs about 60 tokens per hint, at most one per few tool calls.

nudgeTokens.title: Hint threshold (tokens)
nudgeTokens.description: Only results at least this large trigger a hint.

autoFlag.title: Flag redundant older copies automatically
autoFlag.description: When a newer result repeats an older one (a file read again after edits, a command re-run, the same section twice), flag the OLDER copy for trimming without being asked. It is replaced by a short pointer to the newer one and only applied when it pays off against the prompt cache. Older results of the plugin's own inspect_session / trim_session calls are also flagged for deletion (the newest one is kept); those are independent of this option. The agent can cancel any of these with unflag.

similarity.title: Duplicate similarity (0.5–1)
similarity.description: How much of an older result a newer one from a DIFFERENT source (another file or command) must still contain before the older one is flagged automatically. The same file or command is held to a lower bar (this minus 0.35, at least 0.5), because the new version is expected to differ. Raise it to be more cautious.

autoAllowTools.title: Pre-approve the plugin's tools
autoAllowTools.description: Answer Claude Code's permission prompt for this plugin's own two tools (inspect_session, trim_session) so unattended agents are never blocked. They only edit this session's transcript. Turn off to use your normal permission rules instead.
